items.source: This returns an id for the given object. We deliberate use the wording of a generic object id as that might either be the Neo4j 5+ elementId() or on older Neo4j versions or with older data modules toString(id()).
items.translation: 此方法返回给定对象的 ID。我们刻意使用通用对象 ID 的措辞，因为该 ID 可能是 Neo4j 5+ 中的 `elementId()`，也可能是旧版 Neo4j 或旧版数据模块中的 `toString(id())`。

items.source:
This stores all processed nested relations and objects during save of objects so that
the recursive descent can be stopped accordingly.
items.translation: 此功能在保存对象时存储所有已处理的嵌套关系和对象，以便相应地停止递归下降。
